summary: Openmeetings provides a groupware platform featuring video conferencing, instant messaging, whiteboards, and collaborative document editing. It relies on the Red5 Streaming Server to handle remoting and streaming capabilities.
goodFor: Teams looking for an open-source, self-hosted suite that combines video communication with shared document tools under an Apache-2.0 licence.
watchOut: It faces significant competition from much larger, more widely adopted communication platforms, which may offer better client stability or easier integration.
deployNotes: As a Java application, you will typically need to configure a compatible Java runtime environment alongside a reverse proxy for TLS termination and a dedicated database for persistent state.
